title: Design System: Tournova landing (The Court Board)
scope: The landing's board world (court sheets, hatch, the circled clash) lives in src/components/landing/ and is styled by court-sheets.css under .cs-page; the wall, sheet stock, ink, type families, brand mark and focus colour are the app's tokens in src/styles.css. It is the Watch-mode front door of the system in docs/design-principles.md, not a separate product.

primary.note: Read, never redefined: the TournovaMark at 20px and the 2px focus outline. It is not a fill, a link colour or a border on this page.

mark.note: A marker stroke on a picture of paper: the 2.5px ring around the clash, the time that moved, and the tint of the note's shadow. Never a status, never pressable.

ink-soft.note: The stamp column's times: read at a glance across a room, so still dark rather than grey.

rule.note: Every 1.5px line: sheet grid, row rules, the stamp column's edge. A shade softer than the ink it frames.

hatch.note: The pen strokes filling a match slot. rgb(17 17 17 / 0.28) and rgb(17 17 17 / 0.34) are the fine-line and dense steps.

wall.note: The page ground: the board hangs on the same grey as every other Tournova screen.

sheet.note: The court sheets and the clash note: the app's card surface, untoned.

muted-foreground.note: Header nav at rest, and the old time once it is struck through. court-sheets.css records that the struck time still reads at 4.5:1 on the wall and 6:1 on the sheet.

foreground.note: The wordmark, and a nav link on hover.

wordmark.purpose: Tournova beside the 20px mark, at the app header's size: Instrument Sans 600, 1.125rem, -0.02em.

headline.purpose: The promise under the board: the page's h1 in Instrument Sans 600, clamp(2rem, 5.2vw, 3.5rem), balanced to two lines.

subhead.purpose: One line of plain explanation below the actions: Instrument Sans 500, clamp(1.125rem, 2.2vw, 1.5rem).

sheet-title.purpose: "Court N" printed on the sheet's top edge: Roboto Condensed 600, 0.9375rem, uppercase, 0.06em tracked.

time.purpose: The stamp column, one row per slot: JetBrains Mono, 0.75rem, tabular figures so the column reads as a column. The page's only mono.

clash-note.purpose: The circled sentence in Instrument Sans 600, 1rem, Pen Black.

clash-shift.purpose: The "+12 min" beside the note: Instrument Sans 600, 0.875rem.

nav.purpose: Browse tournaments and Sign in as plain links: Instrument Sans 500, 0.875rem, Muted Ink at rest, App Ink on hover.

action.purpose: The one button's label: Instrument Sans 500, 1rem, Sheet White on Pen Black.

link.purpose: The follow link: Instrument Sans 500, 1rem, Pen Black, underlined rather than navy.

shadows.name: sheet-rest
shadows.purpose: Every court sheet, under its tilt and lift: just wide enough to lift the edge off the grey wall.

shadows.name: sheet-lift
shadows.purpose: The same sheet 4px higher on hover.

shadows.name: clash-marked
shadows.purpose: The circled clash note only: ink pressed hard enough to bruise the paper.

borders.name: sheet-rule
borders.purpose: The sheet grid, the stamp column's edge and every row rule. A sheet draws only its top and right rule so neighbours never print a double line.

borders.name: clash-ring
borders.purpose: The highlighter ring around the one clash note.

focus.name: focus-navy
focus.purpose: Every focusable element on the landing. Selection inverts pen and paper (ink background, wall text) so navy stays the mark's alone.

motion.name: sheet-pin
motion.value: cs-pin 520ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1) both; 60ms stagger per sheet
motion.purpose: The sheets pin down in order, from 14px low and twice their tilt. Only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

motion.name: clash-circle
motion.purpose: The circle arrives after the sheets have settled, from scale 0.94. Only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

motion.name: sheet-hover
motion.purpose: A hovered sheet rises 4px. The sheet is an illustration, not a control.

motion.name: action-press
motion.purpose: The one action's fill moves to Raised Black and drops 1px on press.

motion.name: nav-ink
motion.purpose: A nav link moves from Muted Ink to App Ink and underlines.

breakpoints.name: nav-short
breakpoints.note: max-width: 'Browse tournaments' shortens to 'Browse' while the full label stays in the accessibility tree, matching the app header

breakpoints.name: board-tablet
breakpoints.note: six columns; courts 1-3 across the top, clash and court 6 splitting the second row; courts 3, 4 and 5 begin to appear

breakpoints.name: board-wall
breakpoints.note: twelve columns; courts 1-4 across the top, courts 5, the clash and 6 on the second row at staggered heights

components.name: Court Sheet
components.description: The page's unit: a white sheet, tilted and pinned, holding one court's day in a stamp column and a hatched match column.
components.css: .ds-sheet { --rule: #2A2A2A; width: 16rem; padding: 0.875rem 0.875rem 1rem; background: #FFFFFF; border-radius: 3px; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.04), 0 8px 18px -6px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.18), 0 2px 4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.06); transform: rotate(1.4deg); transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 220ms ease; } .ds-sheet:hover { transform: translateY(-4px) rotate(1.4deg); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.04), 0 16px 28px -10px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.24), 0 3px 6px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.07); } .ds-sheet-title { margin: 0 0 0.375rem 0.125rem; color: #111111; font-family: 'Roboto Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-sheet-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; border: 1.5px solid var(--rule); border-left: 0; border-bottom: 0; } .ds-times { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; border-right: 1.5px solid var(--rule); } .ds-times li { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.375rem; height: 1.75rem; padding: 0 0.625rem 0 0.25rem; border-bottom: 1.5px solid var(--rule); color: #3A3D40; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-times s { color: #5B656C; } .ds-moved { color: #D81B8A !important; font-weight: 700; } .ds-slots { background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, transparent 0 7px, rgb(17 17 17 / 0.42) 7px 8px), repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, transparent 0 7px, rgb(17 17 17 / 0.42) 7px 8px); }

components.name: Clash Note
components.description: The one circled clash: a white note inside a 2.5px highlighter ring, with '+12 min' and a hand-drawn arrow beside it.
components.html:
Rest clash:
L. Tran plays 11:10
and 11:22

+12 min
components.css: .ds-clash { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-clash-note { margin: 0; padding: 0.75rem 1.125rem; background: #FFFFFF; border: 2.5px solid #D81B8A; color: #111111; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; text-align: left; box-shadow: 0 6px 16px -8px rgb(216 27 138 / 0.4); } .ds-clash-shift { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; margin: 0; color: #111111; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-clash-shift svg { width: 3rem; height: 1.25rem; fill: none; stroke: #111111; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The page's one action: a printed Pen Black block inside a plain GET form, reachable before the script loads.
components.html: <form action="/tournaments/new" method="get"><button type="submit" class="ds-action">Run a tournament — free</button></form>
components.css: .ds-action { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 1.5rem; background: #111111; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; border: 0; border-radius: 2px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease; } .ds-action:hover { background: #2B2B2B; } .ds-action:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #22397A; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Follow Link
components.description: The secondary road: underlined ink, no arrow, no navy.
components.css: .ds-follow { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; color: #111111; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 1.5px; text-underline-offset: 5px; } .ds-follow:hover { text-decoration-thickness: 2.5px; } .ds-follow:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #22397A; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Header Nav
components.description: The app header's own row: 20px navy mark, Instrument Sans wordmark, plain links in muted ink.
components.css: .ds-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; max-width: 1400px; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; background: #F4F5F4; } .ds-logo { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-height: 44px; color: #171A1D; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.02em; text-decoration: none; } .ds-mark { width: auto; height: 1.25rem; flex-shrink: 0; color: #22397A; } .ds-header nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.25rem; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-header nav a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 0.625rem; color: #5B656C; text-decoration: none; text-underline-offset: 4px; transition: color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-header nav a:hover { color: #171A1D; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 1.5px; } .ds-header :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #22397A; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Stamp Column Row
components.description: One slot of the stamp column: mono tabular time on a 1.75rem ruled row; the moved slot keeps the old time struck and prints the new one bold magenta.
components.css: .ds-rows { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; width: 7rem; border: 1.5px solid #2A2A2A; border-bottom: 0; border-left: 0; } .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.375rem; height: 1.75rem; padding: 0 0.625rem 0 0.25rem; border-bottom: 1.5px solid #2A2A2A; color: #3A3D40; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-row s { color: #5B656C; } .ds-row-moved { color: #D81B8A; font-weight: 700; }

components.description: The promise under the board: two balanced Instrument Sans lines, the page's only large type.

narrative.overview:
The landing is the Watch-mode front door of the same Tournova system described in `docs/design-principles.md`, not a separate product, and it is drawn as the thing the product actually makes: the organiser's board on the hall wall, one printed sheet per court pinned up for the day. Its world lives in `src/components/landing/` — `landing.tsx` for the six sheets and the clash, `court-sheets.css` for everything visual, scoped to `.cs-page`. Nothing else is new. The wall is the app's own `--background`, the sheet is the app's own `--surface`, the type families are the app's, the wordmark and nav are the app header's, and the only two token values the page adds are pen black on the sheet and the app's `--primary` for the mark and the focus ring. A visitor who signs in walks through a door, not into another company.

The page shows a problem already solved. Six court sheets hang slightly askew on the grey wall with a stamped time column and a hand-hatched match column; between them one clash is circled in highlighter magenta — L. Tran plays 11:10 and 11:22 — and next to the circle the sheet it touches already reads the new time with the old one struck through. That is the product's promise drawn before it is said: when a match runs late, the rest of the day keeps up. The headline under the board says the same in one line, and one dark button offers the one action.

Density is low and the two materials are plain: card stock and pen. Every mark on the page is either a rule, a hatch, a struck time or a circle drawn by hand, so the board reads as something a person made at a desk — not a screenshot of software. The only hue the app does not own is the highlighter, and it appears once.
keyCharacteristics: The wall is the app's `--background` and the sheets are its `--surface`; there is no separate landing palette.
One navy, used only by the brand mark and the focus ring; everything else is pen black, paper white and muted grey.
One highlighter magenta, used only for the circled clash and the time it moved.
Times are JetBrains Mono with tabular figures — the one place a visitor sees the app's mono face.
Court names are Roboto Condensed small caps; everything read as interface is Instrument Sans.
Sheets are pinned, not placed: each carries a small tilt, a lift and a paper shadow.
One authored motion: the sheets pin down in order, then the circle is drawn around the clash.

rules.name: The Wall-First Rule
rules.body: The page ground is `--background` and the sheets are `--surface`. Never introduce a landing-only paper, cream or tinted ground: the board has to look like it was pinned to the same wall the app runs on.

rules.name: The One Navy Rule
rules.body: Navy is the mark and the focus ring, and nothing else. Links, borders, titles and the primary action are ink; if a landing element wants to look interactive by being navy, it is wrong — the action is dark and a link is underlined ink.

rules.name: The Highlighter Rule
rules.body: Magenta is a mark drawn on a picture of paper, never a state. It may ring the clash and ink the time that moved; it may not colour a button, a label, an icon or anything a visitor can press. The app has no magenta, and this page keeps it that way.

rules.name: The Blind-Proof Rule
rules.body: Nothing is carried by hue alone: the time that moved is also bold and the old time is also struck through, and the clash is also the only note with a ring.

rules.name: The Clock Is Mono Rule
rules.body: A time on this page is JetBrains Mono with tabular figures. Never set a time in the body face, and never set anything else in the mono face — its use here is a deliberate exception the app does not extend to product UI.

rules.name: The Board Is Not Set In Display Rule
rules.body: Roboto Condensed is on this page for court names only. The headline, the note, the times' neighbours and every control are Instrument Sans; the marketing voice is never condensed.

rules.name: The Struck Time Rule
rules.body: When a slot moves, the old time stays and is struck through, and the new time is bold magenta after it. Replacing the old time, fading it out, or showing only the new one deletes the evidence that the day kept up.

rules.name: The Pinned Rule
rules.body: A sheet is pinned, never placed: each carries its own tilt between -2.2 and 2.4 degrees, its own lift, and a paper shadow. No two sheets share an angle, and nothing except a sheet and the circled note is allowed to be askew.

rules.name: The Rows Meet Rule
rules.body: The sheet rule, the row height (1.75rem) and the hatch's row rhythm are one measurement. If the row height changes, every hatch pattern changes with it, or the board stops looking drawn by hand on ruled stock.

rules.name: The Paper-Lift Rule
rules.body: Elevation exists only where paper lifts off the wall. No shadow on the header, the button, the headline or any CSS-drawn line, and no shadow that is not tied to a sheet or to the circled note.

rules.name: The Ruled-Form Rule
rules.body: If the board prints a line, it is a 1.5px Rule stroke, square, and shared with its neighbour rather than doubled. Rounded corners belong to the paper, not to anything printed on it.

rules.name: The Drawn-Mark Rule
rules.body: The circle and the arrow are the only two marks that are not type or rules, and both must look drawn: a 2.5px ring and a two-path SVG arrow. Never replace them with a chip, a badge, an icon font or a clip-path.

dos: Do build the page from the app's tokens — `--background` wall, `--surface` sheet, `--foreground` ink, `--primary` mark and focus — and keep the `--cs-*` names local to `src/components/landing/court-sheets.css`.
Do reuse the app header's mark, wordmark, nav labels, 44px targets and the 420px short label; the landing header is that header, not a version of it.
Do pin every sheet with its own tilt, lift and shadow, and let the sheets on the second row sit at different heights.
Do strike the old time and print the new one in magenta bold on the same row.
Do keep exactly one circled clash, and let the sheet it touches already show the moved time.
Do print court names in Roboto Condensed small caps and times in JetBrains Mono tabular figures; set everything else in Instrument Sans.
Do give the board a `role="img"` with a label that states the six sheets and the clash, so a screen reader gets the same argument as the picture.
Do run the arrival motion — sheets pinning in 60ms steps, then the circle — only under `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference`, and keep the shared 2px navy focus outline.
donts: Don't invent a landing palette. No cream, no paper tint, no second grey: the wall is `--background` and the sheet is `--surface`.
Don't use navy for links, borders, titles or the action; navy is the mark and the focus ring here.
Don't use magenta on anything a visitor can press, or as a badge/chip/status colour.
Don't set times in the body face or set anything but times in the mono face.
Don't let the hatch encode state, and don't vary its density to mean anything other than which court's sheet it is.
Don't replace the circle, the shift or the arrow with an icon, a pill, a tooltip or a badge; the marks are drawn, not componentised.
Don't add a second primary action, or a nav item whose page does not exist yet.
Don't let any sheet, note or header grow a shadow that is not in the Shadow Vocabulary.
exceptions: JetBrains Mono is used for the clock times, although product UI never uses `font-mono`. A board's times are set in a mono face; the product's own numbers use Saira and Instrument Sans.
Magenta exists only here. The app has green (live), amber (overrun) and red (destructive); this page adds a highlighter hue because the circle is a mark on paper rather than a state the app reports.
The primary action is dark, not navy. The app's primary button is navy; the landing's one action is a printed black block, because on this page navy belongs to the brand mark.
Sheets are 3px-rounded while the app's own surfaces round at up to 1rem (`--radius`); card stock has a corner, a UI surface has a curve.
Selection is ink on the wall (`::selection` inverts pen and paper) rather than the app's navy selection, so the page's one navy stays the mark.

`court-sheets.css` restates the mono stack as `--cs-mono` instead of reading `--font-mono`. The stacks are identical today; the duplicate exists so the landing's type cannot change under the product's token.
